about: The inputs behind the S-H arm (Arm D) and the bromine arm (Arm C-Br) of benchmarks/restart_v3/PREREGISTRATION.md, as the papers print them, so tests/test_restart_v3_references.py can recompute every derived number instead of restating it. Nothing here has been computed by the application. Written 2026-10-27.

constants.d0_to_d298_ethanethiol_source: ervin2015: D0(C2H5S-H) = 359.5 kJ/mol and D298 = 364.7 kJ/mol with thermal enthalpy corrections computed there for the ethyl radical only
constants.borrowed_thermal_note: MY estimate, not published: the same +5.2 kJ/mol is added to the propyl and tert-butyl radicals, and 1.0 kJ/mol is added in quadrature for borrowing it. To be replaced by a computed or published correction before the freeze (section 10).

sh_context.note: Not part of Arm D. Methanethiol's S-H is the first run's lost bond (spent): nicovich1992 Table IX gives 87.35 +- 0.58 kcal/mol at 298 K (85.96 +- 0.68 at 0 K, 2 sigma), ervin2015 uses D0 = 359.7 +- 1.5 kJ/mol as an anchor of the same acidity network, so every Arm D reference shares that anchor with it. Thiophenol is NOT in the arm: borgesdossantos2002 gives 349.4 +- 4.5 kJ/mol (83.5 +- 1.1 kcal/mol, gas phase derived from solution calorimetry) and lim2007 gives D0 = 76.8 +- 0.3 kcal/mol at 0 K; they disagree by about 5 kcal/mol and neither is a 1.0 kcal/mol reference.

other_determinations_kj.method: FT-ICR review, key 2000BOR/ING (Luo Table 3.5; no uncertainty printed)

bromine_excluded.name: tribromomethane C-H
bromine_excluded.reason: no reference passes the 1.0 kcal/mol rule: Luo Table 3.5 gives 401.7 +- 6.7 kJ/mol (96.0 +- 1.6 kcal/mol) and 399.2 +- 8.4; seetula2000's CBr3 formation enthalpy is an ab initio estimate with +-5 kJ/mol; andress2026 calculates 392.4 (FPD) with no uncertainty.
